title: Directors with a perfect ten
statementMd:
List directors who have at least one movie that received a rating of 10.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.name FROM directors d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON r.movie_id = m.id WHERE m.director_id = d.id AND r.rating = 10);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
